newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila bourse to halt trading of waterwork bidders.
newsitem.headline: Manila bourse to halt trading of waterwork bidders.

text.p: The Philippine Stock Exchange said on Thursday it would halt the trading of six listed companies by 9:45 a.m. (0145 GMT) in time for the opening of bids for the privatisation of Metropolitan Waterworks and Sewerage System. where the six would be participating.

The Philippine government is set to open at 10:00 a.m. (0300 GMT) the financial bids of the four consortia bidding for the two 25-year contracts to manage and operate the country's biggest water supply and sewerage system.
Among those shares will be halted by midsession are Benpres Holdings Corp, Ayala Corp, Aboitiz Equity Ventures Inc, Metro Pacific Corp, House of Investments, and Dharmala Philippines Inc.
The latter two companies are minor members of the Aboitiz consortium.
The bourse official said the halt order will be lifted 30 minutes after the result of the bidding has been disseminated to the brokers. - Manila newsroom 63 2 8418938 Fax 8176267
